acceptance_criteria.condition: The three completed V2 trials and their five raw artifacts each are preserved exactly, while the incomplete 30-trial collection is explicitly ineligible.

invariants: No V2 trial is retried, deleted, or added after detecting the preregistered order violation.
V2 diagnostic hidden outcomes cannot be used as an effect, repair-success, or causal-capability result.
The successor protocol must have fresh task IDs and a machine-verifiable predecessor-score sequence credential.

retained_compatibility.consumer: Historical audit of the V2 protocol failure.
retained_compatibility.removal_condition: Permanent immutable archive; it is retained only to prevent accidental reuse or selective retry.

safeguards.name: append-only invalidation
safeguards.rationale: The partial raw artifacts are retained and the collection is labeled ineligible instead of being completed, filtered, or retried.

design_boundary.rationale: The invalidation record owns V2 interpretation and the regression test owns archive completeness checks.

data_ownership.rationale: The immutable raw trial artifacts remain owned by the V2 archive and are not reused by a successor collection.

error_model.rationale: A scheduling protocol deviation becomes an explicit ineligible outcome rather than a silent retry or a failed repair observation.

contract_evolution.rationale: V2 remains unchanged while the successor requires fresh identifiers and stronger order evidence.

operational_budget.rationale: This archival correction launches no agents or service workload.

threat_boundary.rationale: The record retains the shared-filesystem protocol-isolation limit and does not relabel it as a sandbox.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The discovered protocol deviation is archived and tested before any successor experiment is prepared.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The invalidation reason and successor requirement are machine-readable and regression-tested.

reproducibility.rationale: The exact raw files, preregistration hash, freeze commit, and observed scheduling deviation are retained.

verification.result: The V2 invalidation record, 15 raw files, per-condition integrity/public/hidden-injection fields, diagnostic-only outcomes, and unknown causal conclusion were verified.

remaining_risks: The shared-filesystem native environment remains only protocol-isolated.
V2's three diagnostic outcomes do not estimate any Skill effect.
A successor experiment must still run every preregistered trial without retries before it can be analyzed.
